mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate indicates tight monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces consumer and business spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in 60% of cases with high FEDFUNDS, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals strong labor market and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns in 5 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 does not show positive returns in 70% of cases when UNRATE drops below 4%, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) alongside falling industrial production (INDPRO) indicates an imbalance in demand and supply, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If positive returns occur in 50% of cases with rising HOUST and falling INDPRO, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: High retail and food services sales (RSAFS) during late-cycle expansion may signal overextension, leading to negative S&P 500 returns in 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in 60% of high RSAFS cases, the hypothesis is invalid.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns in 5 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 does not show positive returns in 70% of low UNRATE cases, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: CPI exceeding 320 indicates high inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns in 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in 50% of high CPI cases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Rising FEDFUNDS with low UNRATE signals tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If positive returns occur in 40% of cases with rising FEDFUNDS and low UNRATE, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) during early recovery signals economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns in 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 does not show positive returns in 60% of high INDPRO cases, the hypothesis is invalid.
